Definition: to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw
BiblicalUsage: 1) to drag, drag away; 1a) (Qal) to drag away; 1b) (Niphal) to chew the cud; 1c) (Poal) sawn (participle); 1d) (Hithpoel) roaring (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
